The pavilion was first built in the 4th year of Yonghui (653) and named after his title; it stands on the east bank of the Gan River in Nanchang. Destroyed and rebuilt many times, the present pavilion was completed on 8 October 1989. Wang Bo wrote of a banquet and farewell; "the soaring pavilion flowing with vermilion" is the tower he stood on.

不是一回事。龙南的赣南围屋以方形居多，四角有凸出的炮楼，中轴是祠堂；福建土楼「或: No. Longnan's southern-Jiangxi weiwu are mostly square, with protruding corner towers and the ancestral hall on the axis; Fujian tulou are "square or round, mostly round" and were inscribed as World Heritage in 2008. This exhibit follows the Jiangxi line and does not put tulou photos under a southern-Jiangxi label.
以龙南关西新围为例，它「集家、祠、堡为一体」，「中轴线是祠堂」。本展照这个语法把: Take Longnan's Guanxi New Enclosure: it "combines home, shrine and fort", and "the central axis is the ancestral hall". We follow that grammar: gatehouse to ancestral hall is a ritual route, living quarters are in the wings, defence is in the outer wall and towers. Room details are schematic.
角楼就是文献里的炮楼。关西新围「四角各建有一座10米高的炮楼」，围墙厚1米。它把: The corner tower is the "gun tower" of the sources. Guanxi has "a 10-metre gun tower at each corner" and 1-metre-thick walls. It links the inner route of "home" to the outer watch of "defence". Night wind through the loopholes is our sound design.
这张表是本展的叙事约定，不是史料：暮×祖堂为合（黄昏点香），夜×角楼为合（防御值: This table is our narrative convention, not history: Dusk × ancestral hall Compatible (incense), Night × corner tower Compatible (watch), threshing yard × Night Conflict (nothing dries at night; resolved to Dusk), ancestral hall × Noon Borderline (harsh light), gatehouse × Dawn Compatible. The spaces (axis hall, corner towers) are sourced; the hour pairings are design.
禾坪尚空，门楼有雾。脚步声先于人出现。: The threshing yard is still empty; mist at the gate. Footsteps arrive before people.
冷青，墙面刚被天光刮过。: Cold blue-green; daylight has just scraped the wall.
天井灌满白日。蝉在围里，比围外更密。: The skywell fills with daylight. Cicadas are denser inside the walls than outside.
高、白、投影短。祖堂牌位被照得很清楚。: High, white, short shadows. The ancestral tablets are lit clearly.
炮眼先暗，祖堂还亮着。这是围屋把昼交给夜的间隙。: The loopholes darken first while the hall is still lit — the gap where the house hands day to night.
土墙吃进橘色，巷道先一步变成墨。: The earthen wall soaks up orange; the lane turns to ink first.
更鼓与风穿过射击孔。防御建筑在夜里才说出自己的句子。: Night drums and wind pass the firing holes. A defensive building speaks its own lines only at night.
灯只留在祖堂与一处横屋。其余交给墙。: Lamps stay only in the hall and one side room. The rest is left to the walls.
石阶、门枢、远处水牛。晨有鸡。: Stone steps, door pivots, a distant buffalo. Roosters at dawn.
雨水、天光。赣南民居在巷中留竖向天井「以采光排水」，天井「狭小而深」；本展把它画: Rain and daylight. Southern-Jiangxi houses leave vertical skywells in lanes "for light and drainage", "narrow and deep"; we draw it at the centre (schematic).
穿过禾坪，地面微降，四壁把天裁成方形。: Past the yard the floor dips; four walls cut the sky into a square.
雨天有滴阶；晴天有风从巷道灌入。: Dripping eaves on rainy days; wind pours in from the lane on clear days.
巷中留天井，以采光排水: Skywells left in lanes for light and drainage
赣南的天井「狭小而深」。见万幼楠《客家民居与赣南围屋》（客家摇篮网，2014）。: Southern-Jiangxi skywells are "narrow and deep". Wan Younan, Hakka Cradle site, 2014.
晨昏有香；其余时候是极静的木头。: Incense at dawn and dusk; otherwise very quiet wood.
以正厅为中轴的主体房屋：前厅、后厅与两侧厢房、正房合成「正屋」，所有横屋围绕它展: The main block along the central hall: front hall, rear hall and side rooms together form the "main house", with the side wings around it.
从祖堂退到两翼。比横屋更近中轴，也更正式。: Step back from the hall to the wings: closer to the axis than the side wings, and more formal.
坐椅挪动、钟、偶尔的咳嗽。: Chairs shifting, a clock, an occasional cough.
前厅、后厅与厢房、正房合成的主体房屋: Main block of front hall, rear hall and side rooms
正屋两侧扩建的房屋，各房门朝巷开；做饭、睡觉的日常是本展的叙事描写。: Rooms built out on both sides of the main house, doors opening onto the lane; cooking and sleeping are our narrative description.
离开中轴，进入可以做饭、睡觉、说话的尺度。: Leave the axis for the scale of cooking, sleeping and talking.
灶、碗、孩童。午后有人午睡。: Stove, bowls, children. Someone naps after lunch.
正屋两侧扩建，各房门朝巷开: Built out on both sides of the main house; doors open onto the lane
风比别处大。夜里风声会改调。: Windier than elsewhere. At night the wind changes pitch.
正屋与横屋之间的走道称「巷」；围屋顶层另有沿外墙内侧的环形走廊，俗称「外走马」，: The passage between main house and wings is the "lane"; the top floor has a ring corridor inside the outer wall, the "outer horse-run", for moving defenders in wartime. We merge the two into one schematic route linking the wings and the corner tower.
人顺着墙根走，肩会擦到冷砖。这是「可走」最具体的一段。: Walking along the wall your shoulder brushes cold brick. This is the most concrete stretch of "walkable".
回声短，脚步被墙翻倍。: Short echoes; the walls double your footsteps.
顶层沿外墙内侧的环形走廊，战时调兵用: Top-floor ring corridor inside the outer wall, for moving defenders in war
正屋、横屋、巷与天井: Main house, side wings, lanes and skywells
